correctness.rationale: For all \(n\ge2\) and \(\ell\ge0\), neighborhood inclusions permit \(S_n\)-equivariant simultaneous folds: each simplex union its folded image remains independent. Exact surviving blocks \(C_n\) and \(B_n\) have augmentation \(S_n\) homology \(U_n\) in degrees zero and one, respectively; joins give tensor powers. The apex union and long exact sequence yield the only possible nonzero degree; for \(\ell=3k\) the rational \(S_n\) exact extension splits by Maschke, while \(\ell=0\) is separately \(K_{n+1}\). A standalone exact checker confirms 76 fold inclusions, 1,144 permutation Lefschetz traces, 112 separately enumerated signed face traces, and 16 mod-two homology ranks. Finite checks corroborate but do not substitute for the all-parameter proof; integral splitting is not claimed.

value.rationale: The coordinate-permutation action is canonical on generalized Mycielskians and an infinite two-parameter family has long-known nonequivariant sphere multiplicities. Full \(S_n\) homology modules and characters distinguish actions that equal Betti numbers cannot distinguish: \(n=3\), \(\ell=1\) gives a two-dimensional standard character with trace \(-1\) on three-cycles. The residue class of \(\ell\) modulo three yields different tensor-power patterns, a meaningful uniform equivariant refinement and natural structural invariant across all \(n\ge2\) and \(\ell\ge0\); not a finite unmotivated parameter slice. The theorem does not assert an integral or equivariant homotopy splitting.
